label: Phase two — the guest isn't a guest

recentEvents.value: He told the stranger, plainly, that there were families behind this wall. The stranger heard him — and called the children hostages.

unresolvedConflicts.value: The guest isn't a guest. He hears every plea and treats it as tactics.

temporaryObjective.value: Move the crowd first and argue second: lanterns down, little ones inside.

notes: 'You hear me fine, don't you? Lanterns down, little ones inside. The guest isn't a guest.'
